title: How Much Can We Spend?: Indian Coins and Notes up to ₹100
seo_title: Indian Coins and Notes up to ₹100 Class 1 Worksheet with Answers (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 12)
standard_code: Class 1, Joyful Mathematics Chapter 12: How Much Can We Spend?
standard_text: Money: identifying Indian coins and notes, adding small amounts, and simple buying and selling up to ₹100 (summary of NCERT Joyful Mathematics Class 1)
meta_desc: Class 1 How Much Can We Spend? worksheet (Joyful Mathematics Chapter 12): Indian coins and notes, counting money, comparing and shopping up to ₹100. 100 picture questions with answers.
key_big: Count the value, not the number of coins.
key_sub: Start with the biggest note or coin.
body_html:
How to think about it

  • Coins: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10, ₹20. Notes: ₹10, ₹20, ₹50, ₹100.
  • To count money, start with the biggest and count on: ₹50, ₹60, ₹65, ₹67.

Examples

Example

₹20 note, ₹10 coin, ₹5 coin, ₹2 coin

20, 30, 35, 37

Answer: ₹37

Common mistakes

MistakeWhat to do instead
Counting coins one eachA ₹5 coin is worth 5, not 1.
Thinking more coins means more moneyThree ₹1 coins are less than one ₹5 coin.

faq.q: Which coins should Class 1 children know?
faq.a: ₹1, ₹2, ₹5, ₹10 and ₹20 coins, and notes up to ₹100.
Play shop with toy money and small price tags.
